name: End of Day
query:
WITH summary AS ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN si.status NOT IN ('Draft', 'Cancelled') THEN si.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_sales, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN si.paid_amount = 0 THEN si.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS credit_sales, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN si.paid_amount > 0 AND si.paid_amount < si.grand_total THEN (si.grand_total - si.paid_amount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS partially_unpaid, IFNULL(SUM(si.discount_amount), 0) AS total_discount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN si.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_returns FROM `tabSales Invoice` si WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31') AND si.cost_center = COALESCE(%(cost_center)s, si.cost_center) ), payments AS ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS total_payments FROM `tabPayment Entry` WHERE docstatus = 1 AND payment_type = 'Receive' AND posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31') AND mode_of_payment = COALESCE(%(mode_of_payment)s, mode_of_payment) ), payouts AS ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(jea.debit - jea.credit), 0) AS total_payouts FROM `tabJournal Entry` je JOIN `tabJournal Entry Account` jea ON je.name = jea.parent WHERE je.docstatus = 1 AND je.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31') AND jea.account = COALESCE(%(account)s, jea.account) ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '
Total Sales
' AS Label, CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(summary.total_sales, 2), '
') AS Value FROM summary, payments, payouts UNION ALL SELECT '
Total Payments
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(payments.total_payments, 2), '
') FROM summary, payments, payouts UNION ALL SELECT '
Total Activity
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(summary.total_sales + payments.total_payments, 2), '
') FROM summary, payments, payouts UNION ALL SELECT '
Credit Sales
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(summary.credit_sales, 2), '
') FROM summary, payments, payouts UNION ALL SELECT '
Partially Unpaid Amount
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(summary.partially_unpaid, 2), '
') FROM summary, payments, payouts UNION ALL SELECT '
Payouts
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(payouts.total_payouts, 2), '
') FROM summary, payments, payouts UNION ALL SELECT '
Available For Deposit
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(summary.total_sales + payments.total_payments - summary.credit_sales - summary.partially_unpaid + payouts.total_payouts, 2), '
') FROM summary, payments, payouts UNION ALL SELECT '
Discount Amount
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(summary.total_discount, 2), '
') FROM summary, payments, payouts UNION ALL SELECT '
Total Returns
', CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(summary.total_returns, 2), '
') FROM summary, payments, payouts -- ✅ ITEM GROUP SECTION (FIXED) UNION ALL SELECT '
Item Group Summary
', '
' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('
', sii.item_group, '
') AS Label, CONCAT('
$ ', FORMAT(SUM(sii.base_net_amount), 2), '
') AS Value FROM `tabSales Invoice` si JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.posting_date BETWEEN COALESCE(%(from_date)s, '1000-01-01') AND COALESCE(%(to_date)s, '9999-12-31') GROUP BY sii.item_group ) AS report;
